summary: Fase 5 — Full E2E validation of Caja del Día License Server + Admin panel + Public request portal. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (8 legacy + 16 new for request endpoints). Frontend: all 25 Playwright checkpoints pass on the external ingress URL. No bugs found. Approve flow correctly degrades gracefully with empty RESEND_API_KEY (email_sent=false, email_error='resend_not_configured', mailer_configured=false) while still creating the license and returning the JWT. Legacy redirect / → /caja_del_dia.html works.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering is correct: /requests and /requests/{id}/approve|reject are declared BEFORE the parametric /{install_id}, so the literal /requests path is not shadowed. Explicit comment in the code confirms this was a deliberate decision.
MongoDB ObjectId (_id) is correctly excluded from all list responses via projection {_id: 0}. Detail endpoints re-fetch with the same projection. No serialization issues.

Approve endpoint returns a rich shape {request, license, email_sent, email_error, mailer_configured} — the frontend LicenseKeyModal reads all four fields correctly and shows a helpful message when Resend is not configured ('⚠ Resend no configurat (envia manualment)').
AdminLogin.pingAdmin validates the token by hitting GET /api/licenses with the header before persisting it in localStorage. Wrong tokens are never stored — verified in the E2E test (check 15c).
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exclusively; no hardcoded URLs. Admin axios interceptor injects X-Admin-Token from localStorage on every request.
The mailer service is a clean, correctly-async wrapper: is_configured() gates the send path, and asyncio.to_thread() prevents the sync Resend SDK from blocking the FastAPI event loop.

Approve auto-copies JWT to clipboard (best-effort try/catch inside handleApprove) and also exposes a manual '📋 Copiar JWT' button in the LicenseKeyModal — matches the user's spec (JWT auto-copy on approve).
Duplicate-pending check uses {install_id, status:'pending'} — the correct scope so that a previously rejected/approved request does not block a new one for the same install_id.
seed_data_creation: During E2E: created license CD-E2E1-2222-3333-4444 (revoked) + one via approve of request for CD-REQ0-1111-2222-3333, plus one license_requests doc. All cleaned up post-run via mongo (licenses deleted: 2, requests deleted: 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 5 is fully green. If iterating, note: (1) the frontend uses inline styles + sonner Toaster only — no shadcn beyond that; (2) window.prompt() drives revoke reason and approve duration_days, Playwright must use page.once('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept('...'))); (3) empty RESEND_API_KEY is INTENTIONAL until the user finishes their Resend setup — the graceful degradation is a feature, not a bug; (4) legacy / → /caja_del_dia.html redirect uses window.location.replace inside a useEffect, so redirect-page may flash too briefly to catch in headless Chromium (INFO not FAIL); (5) request_id in approve/reject data-testids is the server-generated UUID — the E2E script extracts it dynamically via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="request-row-"]'); (6) legacy caja_del_dia.html was NOT touched, per user's instructions.
